(4) The camera returns to a medium shot of the woman. She expresses extreme shock by widening her eyes and holding her hands up near her head. Red text overlays appear periodically to emphasize financial losses. The setting remains consistent, showing a modern interior with subtle decorative lighting in the background. (5) The woman continues her narrative, her gestures becoming more fluid and emphatic. She uses her hands to mimic a conversation, moving them back and forth. She maintains direct eye contact with the camera, emphasizing the importance of her points. The video ends with her waving once more, the lighting remaining bright and clear throughout.
